spec.title: SGLang: End-to-End Request Latency
spec.description: End-to-end request latency from SGLang metrics (official dashboard query; metric prefix sglang:).

spec.expr: sum by (replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum", model_name=~"$sglang_model_name", replica=~"$sglang_replica"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_count", model_name=~"$sglang_model_name", replica=~"$sglang_replica"}[$__rate_interval]))
